jobs.name: Lara Daily Schedule and Lesson Plans (6pm)
jobs.prompt:
# Lara GWSC Weekly Lesson Plan Report

## Goal
Build Lara's weekly GWSC lesson-plan report as a single text file, formatted exactly as a **daily agenda** (the "Claude" template). The report is then emailed as an attachment to `elshayeb@gmail.com`.

## Output file
`C:\Users\elsha\AppData\Local\hermes\workspace\compass_reports\LARA_LESSON_PLANS_<YYYY-MM-DD>.txt`

## Canonical template rules (MUST follow)
1. **One daily agenda per day.** Every class appears once, as a single block under its day. There is no separate "Daily Schedule Overview", no "Core Lesson Tasks" section, and no separate "Derived Todo List" section — the To-Do is part of each day's agenda.
2. **One field per line, one label per line.** Never merge two fields onto one line and never glue a second label into the middle of a sentence.
3. **Fixed field labels, in this exact order/spelling:** `Time`, `Period`, `Room`, `Teacher`, `Status`, `LI`, `SC`, `Activities`, `Resources`, `Notes`. Do not rename, reorder, or abbreviate. `Time` and `Period` are embedded in the subject heading; the remaining labels each get their own line below `Status`.
4. **Subject heading format:**
   ```
   ### <emoji> Friendly Name (code) — P<n>, <HH:MM>
   ```
   Subject key:
   - `9HUML`   → 🌍 Humanities
   - `9HPEL`   → 🏋️ Health / PE
   - `9SCIL`   → 🧪 Science
   - `9ASMCTT` → 🎭 Drama
   - `9DSEU2`  → 💼 DSE
   - `9MATL`   → 🧮 Maths
   - `9SMBP2`  → 💼 Small Business
   - `9FSCS2`  → 🧪 Forensic Science
   - `9ENGL`   → 📚 English
5. **LI and Notes are a single paragraph** (one or two continuous sentences). **SC, Activities, and Resources are bullet lists** with one distinct item per bullet.
6. **Empty fields are omitted entirely.** Do not print `(none)` or placeholder lines.
7. **No plan published:** print only `Status: No plan published yet` and skip LI/SC/Activities/Resources/Notes.
8. **Room precedence:** use the lesson-plan room if it differs from the timetable room.
9. **Duplicate plans:** if the same subject is taught again later in the week with an identical plan, list it under its own day/period and write `Status: Plan ready (same plan as <day> <period>)`. Do not repeat the body.
10. **Daily To-Do:** after each day's class blocks, add `To-Do — <Day>:` as a checklist (`- [ ]`). Pull bullets **verbatim** from that day's `Activities`. If a class has no `Activities` (no plan, or no set task), it contributes nothing. For English-style plans whose only actionable text is in `SC`, pull the `SC` bullets into the To-Do instead.
11. **Deadlines section:** at the end of the report, add `## Deadlines This Week`. List only graded/assessed items; each deadline is listed once, in full.
12. **No fabricated data.** Missing sessions are `No plan published yet`.
13. **Do not re-extract** if `lesson_plan_results_<today>.json` already exists and contains the current week; reuse it and only reformat.

## Worked example
See `C:\Users\elsha\AppData\Local\hermes\skills\productivity\compass-full-extraction\references\LARA_GWSC_TEMPLATE_EXAMPLE_2026-07-29.txt` for the exact Week 31 report that follows every rule above. Future reports must match this shape.

## Weekly workflow
1. Find or generate the current week's session mapping file:
   `C:\Users\elsha\AppData\Local\hermes\skills\productivity\compass-full-extraction\references\lara-week-<N>-session-mapping.json`
   If it is stale, regenerate it with `python3 generate-week-mapping.py` and then `python3 generate-efficient-js.py`.
2. If `lesson_plan_results_<today>.json` does not already exist, extract lesson plans:
   - Log in to Compass for Lara (targetUserId 24780).
   - Use `lara-week-<N>-extraction-js.json` JS snippets via `browser_console` / `browser_cdp`.
   - Merge results into `lesson_plan_results_<today>.json`.
3. Run the formatter:
   ```
   python3 "C:\Users\elsha\AppData\Local\hermes\skills\productivity\compass-full-extraction\scripts\assemble-lesson-plans.py"
   ```
   It writes the report and prints the path.
4. Send as an attachment:
   ```
   c:\OpenClaw\gog.exe -a aeyeingserver@gmail.com gmail send --to="elshayeb@gmail.com" --subject="Lara GWSC Weekly Report — <Mon date>–<Fri date>" --body-file="<report_path>" --attach="<report_path>" -j
   ```

## Verification before finishing
- Confirm the report file exists and is > 5 KB.
- Confirm every day Mon–Fri is present, each class is a single block, and labels follow the rules above.
- Confirm `gog.exe` returned exit code 0 and a message id.
